messages:
Noah: heads-up: publish CI for sampleapp failed after today's typegen regen. looks like a regen diff bumped a minor in CHANGELOG and broke python client parity tests.
Noah: quick gist of the diff i pulled: 
```
diff --git a/CHANGELOG.md b/CHANGELOG.md
@@
-## 0.9.4
+## 0.10.0
-
+- typegen: reordered query param optionalList -> optional_list (signature change)
+
+## 0.9.4
```
Priya: ouch. did the regen actually change runtime behaviour or just TS/py type shapes?
Leo: i ran `yarn regen --ci --dry-run` locally; the generated Python client swapped positional helper args in `make_request(path, params=None)` -> `make_request(params=None, path)` so runtime callsites fail.
Hana: that's a pretty bad one. sampleapp uses the helper in onboarding code so publish step blows up when we run integration smoke.
Noah: publish logs: `ImportError` in sampleapp demo: wrong number of positional args.
Priya: why did regen bump a minor (0.9.4 -> 0.10.0)? the change looks like churn + docs, not a user-facing API addition.
Leo: regen's bump heuristic currently bumps minor when the type diff touch public surface (types added/removed/reordered). it doesn't detect whether runtime wrappers stayed the same.
Hana: we should never auto-minor for type-only diffs. that's the core ask. also add a CI gate to run the published package's smoke sampleapp tests before publishing.
Priya: immediate plan: 1) revert the runtime param swap in generate_helpers (patch), 2) force-publish patch for python client so sampleapp publish unblocks, 3) follow-up: change regen bump heuristic + add pre-publish sampleapp smoke job.
Noah: can someone take the revert PR? i'll own the force-publish if we have a patch package ready.
Leo: i'll open the revert PR now. also adding a unit test in sdk-core that ensures helper accepts documented arg order and raises for undocumented forms.
Hana: add a test in sampleapp CI that runs the demo import and a tiny request against the staging API. short and fast.
devex-bot: Created issue DEVEX-2401: "regen: avoid minor bump for runtime-compatible type-only changes" linking to PR #4698 (revert) and task #2402 (regen heuristic).
ci-bot: build #4910 failed: publish/sampleapp step. Rerun queued.
Priya: longer term: regen should emit a human-readable summary (types changed vs runtime wrappers changed vs docs-only) and require manual approval to bump anything > patch. auto-patch fine.
Noah: agreed. also add a compatibility shim: when client helper detects older arg order, log a deprecation and adapt for one release cycle. reduces sharp breakage during regen churn.
Leo: shim will buy time while we fix regen heuristics. i'll include it in the revert PR as a small fallback.
Hana: timeline: revert PR + patch publish in next 45m, sampleapp CI smoke added as separate PR today, regen heuristic tracked under DEVEX-2401.
Priya: thanks. tagging @eng-ml to chime in on typegen strategy later, but for now let's get the revert and patch out. :rocket:
Noah: keeping thread for updates. will post links once PR/publish complete.
